name: Government level
description: Tiers of government, named so they hold across countries. National naming varies enormously (commune, municipio, kommun, ward, prefecture); publishers SHOULD pick the closest term here and carry the local name in an additional identifier or alternateName rather than requesting a new term.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Supranational
hasDefinedTerm.description: A body above the national level, e.g. the European Union.

hasDefinedTerm.name: National
hasDefinedTerm.description: The sovereign state. Corresponds to ISO 3166-1.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Regional
hasDefinedTerm.description: A first-level subdivision: state, province, region, land, canton. Corresponds to ISO 3166-2.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Subregional
hasDefinedTerm.description: A second-level subdivision: county, district, department, prefecture.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Municipal
hasDefinedTerm.description: A local authority: city, municipality, commune, town, borough.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Submunicipal
hasDefinedTerm.description: A subdivision of a municipality: ward, parish, neighbourhood council, arrondissement.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Special purpose
hasDefinedTerm.description: A body with a defined remit rather than a general territorial mandate: school district, transit authority, water board.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Indigenous
hasDefinedTerm.description: An Indigenous, tribal, or First Nations government. Deliberately not nested under another level, because its authority is not always territorially derived.
